en.title: Composite Impact Modeling
en.summary: Delamination modeling and visualization for high-speed helicopter components.
en.challenge: Composite helicopter components can sustain internal delamination after impact even when surface damage is limited; simulation needs to reproduce the loading and failure behavior credibly.
contribution: Prepared composite geometry, mesh, material definitions, contacts, and impact boundary conditions.
Ran LS-DYNA impact analyses aligned with ASTM D7136 test principles.
Used Python to post-process force, energy, displacement, and delamination results.
technical: HyperMesh builds and checks the layered finite-element model.
LS-DYNA solves the transient impact response with composite failure and contact behavior.
Python extracts and compares key histories and spatial damage indicators.

architecture.label: Model
architecture.detail: Composite layup, geometry, mesh, materials, contacts, and impactor define the simulation.

architecture.label: Solve
architecture.detail: LS-DYNA calculates transient stress, deformation, energy, and damage evolution.

architecture.label: Post-process
architecture.detail: Python parses solver outputs into comparable engineering indicators.

architecture.label: Validate
architecture.detail: Results are reviewed against test setup, physical expectations, and delamination patterns.

outcomes: Produced an interpretable impact and delamination model for composite structures.
Combined CAE setup, explicit dynamics, standards awareness, and scripted analysis.
Turned large solver outputs into evidence suitable for engineering decisions.

zh.title: 複合材料衝擊建模
zh.summary: 高速直升機部件的分層模擬與視覺化。
zh.challenge: 複合材料直升機部件受到衝擊後，即使表面損傷有限，內部仍可能產生分層；模擬必須可信地重現載入與失效行為。
contribution: 準備複合材料幾何、網格、材料定義、接觸與衝擊邊界條件。
依循 ASTM D7136 試驗原則執行 LS-DYNA 衝擊分析。
以 Python 後處理力、能量、位移與分層結果。
technical: HyperMesh 建立並檢查分層有限元素模型。
LS-DYNA 以複合材料失效與接觸行為求解暫態衝擊響應。
Python 擷取並比較關鍵歷程與空間損傷指標。

architecture.label: 模型
architecture.detail: 複合材料疊層、幾何、網格、材料、接觸與衝擊器共同定義模擬。

architecture.label: 求解
architecture.detail: LS-DYNA 計算暫態應力、變形、能量與損傷演化。

architecture.label: 後處理
architecture.detail: Python 將求解器輸出解析為可比較的工程指標。

architecture.label: 驗證
architecture.detail: 依據試驗配置、物理預期與分層模式檢視結果。

outcomes: 建立可解讀的複合材料衝擊與分層模型。
整合 CAE 建模、顯式動力學、標準規範與程式化分析能力。
將大量求解器輸出轉換為可支援工程決策的證據。
